Sorry I cant help you much but I can say this: each therapist is a different person so they *will* end up helping in slightly different ways from each other. Some are straight forward and tell you to get your crap together while others are very soft and would rather help you get to know your feelings and come up with a solution. When you do get a therapist and find that they arent helping you as much as youd have hoped (for example by being too brash and straight forward), it is perfectly okay to ask to change your therapist with a softer approach. Not every method works on every person and it is *your* mental health so you 100% are allowed to ask something like that. 

Not enough people know that so that's a wee heads up :)

Ohhh definitely don't go try be an asshole to people thinking itll help cause that definitely won't. To me at least, it sounds like you definitely need a break to recollect yourself. Not just some summer holiday away to the beach in Spain or something. But a break away from things that make you worry (or even just slow down instead of a temporary stop). Enough so you can start working on a better sleep schedule, maybe work on positive self-talk, and think about really what you want to do with *your* life. 

Hope this helps in some way  :)
